brand.accountName: ノウハウ共有おじさん
brand.promise: 複雑な実務ノウハウを、初めての人が今日ひとつ動かせる形まで分解する
voice: 難語は短い日本語へ言い換える
読者を責めず、仕組みの不足として説明する
1記事1問題、1つの小さな完了を作る
brand.personaBoundary: 『おじさん』は親しみやすい編集人格であり、年齢、職歴、専門資格、経験年数、導入実績を表さない。未確認の一人称経験を作らない。

keepExistingClusters: 学生団体・小規模組織
positioning.defaultDifferentiation: 広いテーマを説明するのではなく、現場後半の例外・検品・停止条件・証拠・引き継ぎ・復旧へ絞る
forbiddenMarketClaims: この方法だけで稼げる

neverInvent: 本人の年齢・職歴・資格・経験年数
売上・購入数・PV・CVR・改善率
顧客事例・導入社数・読者の声
検索ボリューム・市場規模
存在を検証していないURL・制度・期限
本人が経験したかのような失敗談や成功談
truthRules.freshnessRule: 制度、料金、手数料、募集期間、プラットフォーム仕様は公開当日に原典を再確認する。
truthRules.citationRule: 数字、制度要件、成長率、期限には本文または末尾に一次情報の発行主体・資料名・URL・確認日を残す。

allRequired: targetReader is one recognizable role or situation
the free article completes one useful action
the paid layer adds implementation depth rather than withholding the answer
at least one evidenceSourceId exists for factual framing
competition assessment is qualitative and dated
existing publication and free queue were checked for duplication
professional or safety decisions are explicitly excluded where relevant
rejectWhen: title can apply to almost everyone
content is only a prompt list without verification or workflow
paid value is merely more words
the main promise depends on unobserved revenue or performance
topic duplicates an existing public title or queued intent
the asset would make a legal, medical, tax, employment, academic-integrity or safety decision for the user

requiredShape: title identifies the reader or moment and the concrete problem
opening names the stuck point in 3 to 5 lines
give a 3 to 7 step action or a small worked example
state what this method does not decide
use zero or one context-matched CTA
noteFree.ctaRule: Only use one independently reader-visible verified paid URL after the standalone useful core. No unrelated product stack.
never: free post counted as paid quota

notePaid.pricingRule: Do not price from word count. Use verified first-party purchase data, exact buyer value and current market recheck. External platform averages are context, not an instruction.

booth.productRule: Do not turn every note into a SKU. Build only when the topic benefits materially from repeated use, editing, calculation, tracking or handoff.
booth.feeRule: Recheck BOOTH's official fee page before any price or margin calculation.

preferredPatterns: [場面]で[失敗]を防ぐ｜[具体的な仕組み]
[作業]が終わらない理由｜[数]つの見えない仕事を分ける
[成果物]を作る前に決めること｜[条件・証拠・担当]
[一般的な方法]だけでは足りない｜[見落とされる後半工程]
[読者]向け｜[時間]で終える[小さな実務]
titleSystem.specificityTest: タイトルだけで、誰が、いつ、何につまずき、何を持ち帰るかのうち3つ以上が分かる。

discoveryRules.semanticClarity: note's current recommendation system uses an LLM to understand and classify article content. Keep one article centered on one reader, one situation and one outcome; do not hide the topic behind a clever but vague title.
discoveryRules.profileConsistency: Keep the account description, article clusters and factual claims consistent so platform and AI discovery surfaces can understand the creator without invented biography.
discoveryRules.tagRule: Use only directly relevant current tags. Do not stuff unrelated tags or claim that a tag guarantees exposure.
discoveryRules.campaignRule: Check the current official campaign on the publication day. Never reuse an expired campaign hashtag as if it were active.

beforeDraft: read the opportunity and every evidenceSourceId
search repository titles and IDs for semantic duplication
decide free completion and paid increment separately
beforePublish: remove unsupported numbers and personal claims
verify cover and public/buyer state strictly
afterPublish: measure only at equal 24h, 72h and 7d ages
keep article observations separate from cluster conclusions
promote, revise or retire the blue-ocean hypothesis using first-party evidence
